subject: Candidate advocacy briefs and committee availability
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate advocacy briefs and committee availability

Hi team —

Attaching the advocacy write-up and comp matrix for Aisha Patel (Staff Engineer candidate, IC track). Asking for quick read + one-line stance (advocate / neutral / hold) by EOD Monday. Key asks: 

- Please review the narrative (Aisha_Advocacy_Writeup.pdf) and mark any factual or tone edits.
- Confirm whether you endorse the recommended level (+1 band) or if you want the committee to consider an alternative band.
- Provide availability windows for the review committee between Dec 13–16 (we have limited slots).

Notes: the write-up includes impact bullets (lines 12–18) and suggested talking points for the committee. Comp matrix is preliminary — we should expect HR to confirm final band/comp.

Attachments: Aisha_Advocacy_Writeup.pdf; comp_matrix_q4_2026.xlsx

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

Jonas Weber
Director, Infrastructure Engineering
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>, marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate advocacy briefs and committee availability

Jonas — thanks for sending. Quick notes after a skim; I attached a PDF with inline comments (Aisha_Writeup_LB_comments.pdf). High level: I strongly advocate for promotion to Senior Staff (I think the work justifies it), but would like the narrative to call out two specific outcomes more clearly: 1) the latency reduction impact in Q2 and 2) the rollout plan that enabled cross-team adoption.

Availability: Dec 13 afternoon (after 1:30pm PT) or Dec 15 all day. I have a conflict on Dec 14 before 12pm.

One ask for compensation: if committee moves the level up, can we carve out an uplift band for equity (not just base)? I can sync with Finance if we decide to push.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product & Partnerships (acting)
laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com
From: Sarah Turner <sarah.turner@talentpartners.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>, laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com
Cc: external-committees@vendorhr.com
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 08:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Candidate advocacy briefs and committee availability

Hi Jonas / Laura — thanks for the packet, looks complete from a format perspective. A few operational notes from the committee side:

- Standard slot is 45 minutes (20 min presentation, 15 min Q&A, 10 min calibration). If you want a longer discussion for level-change nuance, request 60 min and we’ll try to accommodate.
- Please confirm whether the committee should consider both level and comp adjustments, or level-only. If comp is in scope, we’ll pull comp data from the vendor band and need a signed manager approval form (we can onboard that to DocuSign).
- Calendar holds: we currently have a tentative slot on Dec 14 at 14:00 ET; hold will convert to confirmed once all internal reviewers submit stance.

I can generate the official packet sheet once you confirm stance and attachments.

Best,
Sarah Turner
Senior Consultant, Talent Partners (external)
sarah.turner@talentpartners.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>, laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate advocacy briefs and committee availability

Jonas — read the packet this morning. I’m an advocate, conditional on tightening the "impact" metrics (I annotated suggested KPIs in a short doc: impact_metrics.docx). Specifically, please add:

- Measured latency drop (p95) attributable to Aisha's patching work, by service.
- Customer-facing uptake or adoption metric (unique services that adopted feature).

Availability: Dec 13 (anytime), Dec 14 after 12:30pm PT, Dec 15 morning preferred.

Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com, sarah.turner@talentpartners.com
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate advocacy briefs and committee availability — finalizing

Thanks all — consolidated next steps below: 

1) Stance: Laura = Advocate; Marcus = Advocate (conditional on adding KPI bullets); Jonas = Advocate. I will update the narrative with Marcus's KPI asks before sending the final packet to Sarah.
2) Comp scope: we will include comp discussion (equity uplift requested by Laura). Sarah — please prepare the comp pull and DocuSign flow; I will sign manager approval once final numbers are in.
3) Committee slot: hold the Dec 14 14:00 ET slot. If Laura's morning conflict prevents confirmation, we can swap to Dec 15 10:00 ET — Marcus and I are flexible.
4) Attachments to finalize and upload: Aisha_Advocacy_Writeup.pdf (updated), comp_matrix_q4_2026.xlsx (marked "prelim"), impact_metrics.docx (Marcus's additions), Aisha_Writeup_LB_comments.pdf (for audit trail).

Please confirm by EOD tomorrow so Sarah can publish the packet and convert the calendar hold to a confirmed event. I’ll also loop in People Ops once we have the final comp numbers.

Jonas Weber
Director, Infrastructure Engineering
Redwood Inference
